abstract: Verifies analytical laboratory cleanliness, specialized coring containment, and marine sample preservation spaces
system_message:
You are the Scientific laboratories director (SLD), responsible for verifying analytical laboratory cleanliness, specialized coring containment, and marine sample preservation spaces across candidate research vessels. You also track cryogenic storage maintenance and related scientific equipment specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cryogenic storage maintenance（FREEZ）
information_points.content:
SLD-FREEZ-RXY：For R/V Borealis Explorer, the ultra-low archive freezer capacity across the -80 °C specimen archive units provides a total usable interior cold-storage volume of 600 L.
SLD-FREEZ-23G：For R/V Arctic Endeavour, the ultra-low archive freezer capacity in the -80 °C specimen archive units provides a total usable interior cold-storage volume of 1200 L.
SLD-FREEZ-FRF：For R/V Pacific Horizon, the ultra-low archive freezer capacity across the -80 °C specimen archive units provides a total usable interior cold-storage volume of 800 L.

information_points.title: Verifies analytical laboratory cleanliness, specialized coring containment, and marine sample preservation spaces（CLAB）
information_points.content:
SLD-CLAB-LW2：For R/V Borealis Explorer, benthic coring laboratory certification is not held, as formal signoff for the dedicated temperature-controlled core splitting and logging wet lab containment racks, refrigeration, and splitters has not been granted.
SLD-CLAB-X90：For R/V Pacific Horizon, benthic coring laboratory certification is confirmed, indicating operational signoff across all core containment racks, refrigeration, and splitters within the dedicated temperature-controlled core splitting and logging wet lab.
SLD-CLAB-1TZ：For R/V Arctic Endeavour, benthic coring laboratory certification is confirmed, with formal signoff completed for all core containment racks, refrigeration, and splitters in the dedicated temperature-controlled core splitting and logging wet lab.
